en.html:
邦氏"...D-Doushin! Doushin!!"
邦氏"S-stop it! This... this is outrageous!"
童心"Well, well..."
邦氏"..."
童心"Did Your Highness say something just now?"
邦氏"W-what?"
童心"Unfortunately I am in the middle of a dance. The performer's rule, Highness. Even if news comes that his own parent is dying, he does not leave the stage."
童心"Your business I will take up after this・・ is finished. For now, please forgive me, Highness."
邦氏"Fool! I am telling you to stop that!!"
童心"Kya zamaana aa gaya. Such a troublesome young lord! The finer things are wasted on him..."
童心"If you must insist, then why not give an order to someone?"
邦氏"What...?"
童心"Tell your retainers: 'This Kubo of Koga. This lay priest, Doushin Yusa.'"
童心"'Drag him down from that stage.' Go on. Say it to them."
邦氏"............"
邦氏"G-Go!!"

en.html:
童心"Arre, what has the flower done to you? Such cruelty to an innocent thing!"
童心"And now you would silence me before I have finished my criticism!"
Sakurako"Stop this! You monster!"
童心"You crush the flower; I am the monster. Very convenient, this division of responsibility."
童心"First the flower, now my character. All that fine breeding—and such manners!"
Sakurako"............"
童心"Even the silence is disapproving. A princess wastes nothing."
童心"Such distinction! A whole audience, and still you think only of how you are being treated."
Sakurako"...Ah..."
童心"No, the answer is not satisfactory. Apparently I have not made myself unpleasant enough."
童心"I have considerably worse to say. We are nowhere near the end."
Sakurako"!"
Sakurako"Please... stop..."
童心"Please? Ab aayi na baat. Now we remember our manners."

en.html:
Sakurako"Ah..."
Sakurako"...Ah..."
童心"There now. Who else could manage a performance like this?"
童心"Such refinement! Where else would you find such a considerate critic?"
Sakurako"...Kubo... of Koga..."
Sakurako"Doushin... Yusa...!"
童心"Oho. A different tone altogether."
童心"Earlier, you gave us of Rokuhara leave to speak of Okabe, did you not?"
Sakurako"............"
童心"Then let us reverse the arrangement. You speak for Okabe; tell us about Rokuhara."
童心"Come. I am waiting for your answer."
Sakurako"...Ah..."
童心"Princess of Okabe. What sort of people are we of Rokuhara?"
Sakurako"...Vile..."
童心"Yes."
Sakurako"Not... human..."
童心"Quite."
Sakurako"A rabblerabble... from hell...!"
童心"EXACTLY!"

en.html:
童心"At last! An assessment that does us justice!"
童心"They tell an old monk to renounce his importance. But who will manage things if I oblige?"
童心"Let paradise wait. This world plainly cannot do without me."
童心"And I have much more to say to you yet."
Sakurako"...!"
童心"What would your father say, hearing you now? And your brother?"
Sakurako"...What...?"
童心"More protests? I shall take them as encouragement."
童心"I have not exhausted my criticisms of you. Not by a very long way."
童心"Huh-huu! An old man’s habits do not change so easily."
Sakurako"NO...! STOP...!"

童心 「たまらぬ！　たまらぬわえ！ 　何と官能的な調べであろう！」
童心 「うっかり成仏してしまいそうじゃわ！ 　姫よ、わしが往生してしまわぬよう、しっ かり締めて捕まえておいてくれい！」
童心 「この喜悦は現世限りのもの。 　これあると知れば、わしはたとえ極楽から でも戻って来られるからのぅ！」
童心 「それ、参るぞ！」
桜子 「く……あぁぁ!!」
童心 「父と兄に良く見てもらえぃ！ 　仇に子種を注がれる姿……とくとのう！」
桜子 「!? 　なっ――そんな」
童心 「おう、暴れるでない。 　そう喜ぶでない」
童心 「焦らずとも、きちんと孕ませてやるからの。 　その後は……菊の花・・・じゃ」
童心 「そちらもなかなか乙なものぞ？ 　ふわっはっはっはっはっはっはっはっは!!」
桜子 「いやぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーーーーっ!!」
